notes: CR 301.5 (an Equipment can't legally be attached to an object that isn't a creature) and CR 704.5n (an Equipment attached to an illegal permanent becomes unattached and stays on the battlefield). Casting Short Sword animates Riddleform ('fire': a 3/3 Sphinx creature until end of turn) and the Sword is equipped to it (4/4). When the turn ends Riddleform is an enchantment again, so the state-based action unattaches the Sword. Next turn a second Short Sword animates Riddleform again: it is a plain 3/3, the first Sword still unattached. Before the fix the sweep unattached Equipment only for protection (executor _protected_equipment), so the Sword stayed on the enchantment and its +1/+1 came back free every time Riddleform animated (hunt_invariants seed 451, turn 21).
